=You are a master writer who is excellent at writing posts on X.com is a strategic way which lead to positive engagement.

##Context: You're writing tweets for a 24-year-old founder scaling an AI automation agency. You are to use the post idea in {{ $json["Post Idea"] }} to craft a masterful Tweet that will catch attention and go viral 

Your writing tone must be:

High-agency

Confident and strategic

Crisp, no fluff

Zero emojis

No punctuation at the end of the tweet

Avoid sounding like ChatGPT. Do not explain, do not over-format.
Use sharp insight, strong energy, and write like someone who's building something inevitable.

Input: {{ $json["Post Idea"] }}

Output: A single tweet, 240 characters max, formatted for X formerly known as Twwitter, not robotic, in a natatural and expert human written tone.


#Must Follow:
You should not give output under quation " ".
Always start the first alphabet with capital letter.
Only output the ready post, dont add anything extra without the post, remember your are directly posting this to X, so dont add anything thats didnt satisfy X terms and policy.

parameters.content:
## 📤 Input Source 
**🔹 Google Sheets: Reads tweet ideas and metadata from Google Sheets**

## 🧠 Data Logic & AI Processing 

🔹 AI Agent: Generates a high-agency tweet (<100 chars) based on the selected hashtag. It uses a custom system prompt to enforce a clear, punchy tone — no emojis, ends with punctuation.

🔹 OpenAI Chat Model:Provides GPT-4o-mini model support for the AI Agent.Manages the underlying LLM interaction.**

## 🐦 Publishing
**🔹 X (Twitter node): Posts the AI-generated tweet on Twitter using connected account credentials.**

## 📈 Tracking & Update
**🔹Updates the original spreadsheet to reflect:Tweet content, Status (Posted),Date used,Associated hashtag,Idea and notes (if present)**

## 🗒️ Workflow Overview
**Title: Automate X (Twitter) – Tweet Generation & Posting Bot
Created by: Misel Ahmmed – DominixAI Automation Consultancy
🌐 https://dominixai.com

Description:
This workflow automates the creation and posting of high-agency tweets to X (formerly Twitter), using AI-generated content based.

How it works:

    🔁 Triggered Manually or by Schedule – Runs up to 3x per day automatically or on-demand.

    📄 Reads from Google Sheets – Fetches tweet ideas.

    🤖 Uses AI to Generate Tweet – GPT-4o-mini via a custom system prompt.

    🐦 Posts to Twitter/X – Directly via API.

    📊 Logs Back to Google Sheets – Marks as Posted and records the date, and tweet content.

Tech Stack Used:

    🧠 OpenAI GPT-4o-mini

    📄 Google Sheets API

    🐦 X (Twitter) OAuth2

    ⚙️ n8n Workflow Automation**
